edition_policy: Only current and fixed legacy remain visible. No intermediate profile or new old-spelling aliases.

rationale.tril: User adopted 颤音: 音 covers both vocal and instrumental trills, while preserving the existing root and annotations.
rationale.sfinks: User adopted 人面狮: 人 identifies the human face, 面 the face, and 狮 the lion body of the sphinx; preserve mythical and zoological senses in annotations.
rationale.alcion: User adopted shared bird category 鸟 with generated identifier ᴬᴸ; do not retain 翠 as a dedicated character.
rationale.alced: Identifier propagation only: generated shared-bird allocation moves this root from 鸟ᴬᴸ to 鸟ᴬᴰ. The fixed legacy dictionary keeps 鸟ᴬᴸ=alced; current must resolve it to alcion.
